levelTitle: Level 0 - Teen Startup / Nivel 0 - Inicio adolescente

classes.title: Class 1: Hello & Introductions / Clase 1: Hello & Introductions
classes.objective: Master the topic of Hello & Introductions.
classes.s2Details:
Saying Hello & Asking Names 👋 / Saludos y Nombres -> Formal: Hello! / Good morning! / Nice to meet you! | Informal: Hey! / What's up? / How's it going? | Feelings: I'm great! / I'm fine, thanks / Not bad, you?
The Introduction Formula 📝 / Fórmula de Presentación -> Formula: [Greeting] + [I'm Name] + [Nice to meet you] + [How are you?] | Example 1: 'Hey! I'm Alex. Nice to meet you! How are you today?' | Example 2: 'Good morning! My name is Sofia. I'm great, and you?'
Quick Check: Say Hi! 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher out loud: | 1. Greet the teacher politely. | 2. State your name and how you feel today!

classes.title: Class 2: Numbers, Ages & Birthdays / Clase 2: Numbers, Ages & Birthdays
classes.objective: Master the topic of Numbers, Ages & Birthdays.
classes.s2Details:
Numbers 1-31 & Birthday Months 🎂 / Números y Meses -> Numbers 1-10: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten | Numbers 11-20: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, twenty... | Months: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
The Age & Birthday Formula 📅 / Fórmula de Edad y Cumpleaños -> Age Formula: I am + [Number] + years old. (Never say 'I have 14 years') | Birthday Formula: My birthday is IN + [Month]. | Example: 'I am 14 years old and my birthday is in October.'
Quick Check: Birthday Card 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Complete and say out loud to the teacher: | 'I am ________ years old and my birthday is in ________.'

classes.title: Class 3: My Body & Actions / Clase 3: My Body & Actions
classes.objective: Master the topic of My Body & Actions.
classes.s2Details:
Body Parts & Action Verbs 💪 / Partes del Cuerpo y Acciones -> Body: Head, arms, legs, hands, feet, eyes, ears | Actions: Run fast, jump high, dance, swim, play soccer, skate | Which action do you do every week?
The Ability Formula: CAN vs CAN'T ⚡ / Fórmula de Habilidades -> Positive (+): I CAN + [Verb] -> 'I can skate very well.' | Negative (-): I CAN'T + [Verb] -> 'I can't swim yet.' | Contrast: 'I can play soccer, but I can't dance hip-hop.'
Quick Check: Talent Show 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 1. Name 2 cool things you CAN do. | 2. Name 1 action you CAN'T do yet!

classes.title: Class 4: My Favorite Gadgets & Tech / Clase 4: My Favorite Gadgets & Tech
classes.objective: Master the topic of My Favorite Gadgets & Tech.
classes.s2Details:
Gadgets, Tech & Adjectives 📱🎧 / Tecnología y Adjetivos -> Devices: Smartphone, laptop, headphones, smartwatch, gaming console, tablet | Adjectives: Fast, cool, useful, modern, portable, expensive | What is your #1 favorite device?
The Tech Possession Formula 💻 / Fórmula de Posesión -> I / You / We / They -> HAVE | He / She / It -> HAS | Formula: Subject + have/has + a/an + [Adjective] + [Device] | Example: 'I have wireless headphones and they are super useful for music.'
Quick Check: Favorite Device 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'I have a ________ and it is very ________.' | What do you use it for most?

classes.title: Class 5: Food Likes, Dislikes & Flavors / Clase 5: Gustos, disgustos y sabores
classes.objective: Usar like/don’t like, Do you like...? y adjetivos simples de sabor.
classes.s2Details:
Snacks, Drinks & Flavors 🍕🥤 / Snacks y Sabores -> Snacks: Pizza, burger, popcorn, nachos, cookies, fruit salad | Drinks: Lemonade, bubble tea, iced tea, soda, water, smoothie | Flavors: Sweet (dulce), salty (salado), spicy (picante), delicious
The Preference Formula: LIKE & BECAUSE 😋 / Fórmula de Gustos -> Like (+): I like / I love [Food] because it is [Flavor]. | Dislike (-): I don't like [Food] because it is too sweet / salty. | Example: 'I love bubble tea because it is cold and sweet!'
Quick Check: Snack Attack 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 1. What is your #1 favorite snack and why? | 2. One food or drink you really dislike!

classes.title: Class 6: Shapes & Patterns / Clase 6: Shapes & Patterns
classes.objective: Master the topic of Shapes & Patterns.
classes.s2Details:
Shapes, Colors & Patterns 📐🎨 / Formas y Diseños -> Shapes: Circle, square, triangle, rectangle, star | Patterns: Striped (rayas), dotted (puntos), plain (liso), checkered (cuadros) | Colors: Dark blue, light green, neon pink, matte black
The Object Description Formula 🔍 / Fórmula de Descripción -> Formula: It is a + [Color] + [Pattern/Shape] + [Object]. | Example 1: 'My hoodie is dark blue and striped.' | Example 2: 'My notebook is a neon pink rectangle.'
Quick Check: Describe an Item 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Look around your room or desk right now: | 'It is a (color) and (shape/style) ________.' | Say your sentence out loud to the teacher!

classes.title: Class 7: School Subjects & Supplies / Clase 7: School Subjects & Supplies
classes.objective: Master the topic of School Subjects & Supplies.
classes.s2Details:
School Subjects & Backpack Gear 🎒📚 / Materias y Útiles -> Subjects: Math, Science, English, History, Art, P.E. (Physical Education) | Supplies: Backpack, notebook, pencil case, pens, ruler, scissors, calculator | Which school subject is your absolute favorite?
The Backpack Formula: THERE IS / THERE ARE 🎒 / Fórmula de Existencia -> Singular (1): In my backpack, THERE IS a calculator and a notebook. | Plural (2+): In my backpack, THERE ARE three pens and two highlighters. | Example: 'In my pencil case, there is an eraser and there are two markers.'
Quick Check: Backpack Scan 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 1. What is your favorite school subject? | 2. Name 2 items in your bag using 'There is...' and 'There are...'

classes.title: Class 8: Pets & Animal Friends / Clase 8: Pets & Animal Friends
classes.objective: Master the topic of Pets & Animal Friends.
classes.s2Details:
Pets & Animal Friends 🐶🐱 / Mascotas y Animales -> Pets: Dog, cat, parrot, hamster, rabbit, turtle, fish | Wild Animals: Lion, dolphin, eagle, tiger, monkey | Adjectives: Playful, smart, fast, furry, cute, loyal
The Animal Spotlight Formula 🐾 / Fórmula de Animales -> Formula: My favorite animal is the [Animal] because it is [Adjective] and can [Action]. | Example 1: 'My dog is very playful and he can fetch the ball.' | Example 2: 'Dolphins are smart and can swim very fast in the ocean.'
Quick Check: Animal Kingdom 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'My favorite animal is the ________ because it is ________ and can ________.'

classes.title: Class 9: My Hobbies & Free Time / Clase 9: My Hobbies & Free Time
classes.objective: Master the topic of My Hobbies & Free Time.
classes.s2Details:
Hobbies & Free Time Activities 🎮🎨 / Pasatiempos -> Gaming, drawing, playing guitar, listening to music, watching anime | Skateboarding, photography, baking, coding, dancing TikTok dances | Time: In my free time / On weekends / After school
The Hobby Expression Formula 🎧 / Fórmula de Hobbies -> Formula: In my free time, I love/enjoy + [Verb-ing] because it is [Reason]. | Example 1: 'In my free time, I really enjoy playing online games with friends.' | Example 2: 'On weekends, I prefer listening to music because it relaxes me.'
Quick Check: Hobby Spotlight 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'In my free time, I really enjoy ________ because it is ________.'

classes.title: Class 10: Family, Possessives & People / Clase 10: Familia, posesivos y personas
classes.objective: Identificar relaciones y describir una persona mediante posesivos y adjetivos básicos.
classes.s2Details:
Family Members & Traits 🏠👥 / Familia y Rasgos -> Parents: Mother (Mom), Father (Dad) | Siblings: Brother, Sister | Extended: Grandmother, Grandfather, Uncle, Aunt, Cousin | Traits: Kind, funny, creative, hardworking, tall, cheerful
The Family Intro Formula: POSSESSIVES 🔑 / Fórmula de Familia -> Formula: This is my [Relative]. (His/Her) name is [Name] and (he/she) is [Trait]. | Example 1: 'This is my sister. Her name is Sofia and she is very creative.' | Example 2: 'This is my brother. His name is Leo and he loves soccer.'
Quick Check: Family Intro 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Introduce 1 family member to the teacher: | 'This is my ________. (His/Her) name is ________ and (he/she) is ________.'

classes.title: Class 11: Alfabeto, deletreo and usernames / Clase 11: Alfabeto, deletreo y usernames
classes.objective: Master the topic of Alfabeto, deletreo y usernames.
classes.s2Details:
Alphabet, Vowels & Tricky Letters 🅰️🗣️ / El Alfabeto -> Vowels: A /ei/, E /i:/, I /ai/, O /ou/, U /ju:/ | Tricky Letters: G /dʒi:/ vs J /dʒei/ | H /eitʃ/ | R /ɑ:r/ | W /dʌbəl ju:/ | Y /wai/ | Z /zi:/ | Symbols: @ = 'at' | _ = 'underscore' | . = 'dot'
The Spelling & Handle Formula 📱 / Fórmula de Deletreo -> Name Spelling: 'My name is ALEX -> A - L - E - X.' | Username Formula: 'My handle is @alex_gamer -> alex underscore gamer at instagram dot com.' | Question: 'How do you spell your last name, please?'
Quick Check: Spell It Out! 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Spell your first name letter by letter to the teacher: | Example: 'My name is LUCAS -> L - U - C - A - S'

classes.title: Class 12: My Teen Profile / Clase 12: Mi perfil adolescente
classes.objective: Crear una presentación completa sin volver a enseñar los saludos de la clase 1.
classes.s2Details:
Personal Profile & Goals 🪪🌟 / Perfil Personal -> Facts: Name, Age (I am 14), City & Country (I live in Medellin), Grade (9th grade) | Goals: I want to learn English to travel / chat with gamers / study abroad | Connectors: Use 'AND' for extra facts, 'BUT' for contrasts
The Complete Bio Formula 🗣️ / Fórmula de Biografía -> Formula: Hi! I'm [Name], [Age] years old from [City]. I love [Hobby] and I want to [Goal]! | Example: 'Hi! I'm Mateo, 15 years old from Cali. I love video games and I want to travel the world!'
Quick Check: 20-Second Bio 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Deliver your bio to the teacher in 3 complete sentences: | 1. Name, age, city. | 2. Favorite hobby. | 3. Your goal in English!

classes.title: Class 13: Clothes, estilo personal and apariencia / Clase 13: Ropa, estilo personal y apariencia
classes.objective: Master the topic of Ropa, estilo personal y apariencia.
classes.s2Details:
Clothes, Sneakers & Style 👖👟 / Ropa y Calzado -> Clothes: Hoodie, jacket, t-shirt, jeans, cargo pants, shorts, cap, sunglasses | Shoes & Bags: Sneakers, boots, backpack | Appearance: Tall, short, curly hair, straight hair, dark eyes
The Outfit Formula: PRESENT CONTINUOUS 🧥 / Fórmula de Outfit -> Formula: Today I am wearing a [Color/Item] with [Color/Item] and [Shoes]. | Example 1: 'Today I am wearing an oversized black hoodie with blue jeans and white sneakers.' | Example 2: 'She is wearing a green jacket, dark sunglasses, and cool boots.'
Quick Check: Outfit Scanner 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Look down at your clothes right now: | 'Today I am wearing a ________ and ________.' | Tell the teacher your outfit!

classes.title: Class 14: Lost & Found at School / Clase 14: Objetos perdidos en la escuela
classes.objective: Preguntar dónde está un objeto y describir su ubicación con preposiciones.
classes.s2Details:
Classroom Spaces, Items & Prepositions 🪑🏫 / El Salón de Clases -> Objects: Desk, chair, whiteboard, projector, clock, door, laptop, backpack | Prepositions of Place: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of | Commands: Open your book, take notes, raise your hand
The Classroom Location Formula 📍 / Fórmula de Ubicación -> Formula: The [Object] is [Preposition] the [Location]. | Example 1: 'The notebook is ON the desk next to the laptop.' | Example 2: 'The backpack is UNDER the chair behind Sofia.'
Quick Check: Classroom Detective 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Where is your pen or phone right now? | 'My (pen/phone) is (on/under/next to) the ________.' | Say it out loud to the teacher!

classes.title: Class 15: Rutina diaria básica / Clase 15: Rutina diaria básica
classes.objective: Master the topic of Rutina diaria básica.
classes.s2Details:
Daily Routine & Telling Time 🌅⌚ / Rutina y Horas -> Routine Verbs: Wake up, take a shower, have breakfast, go to school, do homework, go to bed | Telling Time: 7:00 (seven o'clock) | 7:15 (a quarter past seven) | 7:30 (half past seven) | 7:45 (a quarter to eight) | Prepositions: AT + hour (at 6:30 AM) | IN + part of day (in the morning, in the evening)
The Daily Routine Formula 🔄 / Fórmula de Rutina -> Formula: I [Routine Action] at [Time] [Part of Day]. | Example 1: 'I wake up at 6:30 AM in the morning.' | Example 2: 'I do my homework at 4:00 PM in the afternoon.'
Quick Check: Daily Clock 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 1. What time do you wake up on school days? | 2. What time do you go to sleep?

classes.title: Class 16: Level 0 Review & Final Challenge 🏆 / Clase 16: Level 0 Review & Final Challenge 🏆
classes.objective: Review and master all vocabulary and grammar from Level 0.
classes.s2Details:
Level 0 Grand Review: Personal Bio & Skills 🌟 / Gran Repaso -> Bio: Greetings, name, age (I am 15), birthday month, city | Abilities & Tech: I can skate (can/can't), I have a laptop (have/has) | Routine & Style: Today I am wearing a hoodie, I wake up at 7:00 AM
The Startup Capstone Formula 🎓 / Fórmula Final -> 1. Introduce yourself & how you feel. | 2. Share 1 thing you have and 1 thing you can do. | 3. State your favorite hobby and routine time. | Example: 'Hi! I'm Leo, 15. I have headphones, I can play soccer, and I love gaming!'
Quick Check: Grand Startup Pitch 🎯 / Gran Reto -> Deliver your 30-second Level 0 English pitch to the teacher! | Show everything you learned in Level 0!

levelTitle: Level 1 - Teen Explorer / Nivel 1 - Explorador adolescente

classes.title: Class 1: People Profiles, Friendship & Feelings / Clase 1: Perfiles, amistad y emociones
classes.objective: Crear perfiles de personas usando this/these, have/has, feelings y personality adjectives.
classes.s2Details:
People in Your Circle / Personas cercanas -> Friend, classmate, teammate, neighbor, cousin | This is my classmate, Eva. | These are my teammates.
Personality Words / Personalidad -> Friendly, quiet, funny, creative, helpful | Leo is creative and helpful. | Use be for personality and feelings.
Feelings Can Change / Emociones -> Excited, worried, tired, calm, proud | My friend is worried about the test. | Ask: How does he or she feel?

classes.title: Class 2: Healthy Habits, Food & Energy / Clase 2: Hábitos saludables, comida y energía
classes.objective: Relacionar comida, agua, sueño y movimiento con energía usando because.
classes.s2Details:
Food for Energy / Comida y energía -> Fruit, vegetables, protein, grains | Different foods help the body in different ways. | Build a meal, not a restaurant order.
Water and Drinks / Agua y bebidas -> Water helps you stay focused. | Too much soda can reduce steady energy. | I choose water because I have practice.
Sleep and Movement / Sueño y movimiento -> Sleep, walk, stretch, exercise | Healthy energy is not only about food. | I sleep eight hours on school nights.

classes.title: Class 3: Weather Forecast & What to Bring / Clase 3: Pronóstico y qué llevar
classes.objective: Describir el pronóstico y decidir qué usar o llevar según las condiciones.
classes.s2Details:
Read the Forecast / Leer el pronóstico -> Sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy, hot, cold | It will be rainy this afternoon. | Focus on conditions and decisions, not a clothing list.
Temperature and Conditions / Temperatura -> It is 12 degrees and windy. | The morning is cool, but the afternoon is warm. | Use and/but to connect conditions.
What Do You Need? / ¿Qué necesitas? -> You need an umbrella. | Bring water and a cap. | Wear comfortable shoes.

classes.title: Class 4: Nature, Locations & Park Rules / Clase 4: Naturaleza, ubicación y reglas del parque
classes.objective: Usar there is/are, preposiciones e imperativos para describir y proteger un parque.
classes.s2Details:
Outdoor Places / Lugares al aire libre -> Park, trail, lake, garden, playground | There is a lake near the trail. | There are trees around the playground.
Locate Nature / Ubicar la naturaleza -> next to, behind, between, across from | The garden is behind the café. | Two benches are next to the lake.
Describe What You See / Describir -> There is + singular or uncountable | There are + plural | Add color, size, or condition.

classes.title: Class 5: Weekend Intentions & Simple Plans / Clase 5: Intenciones y planes de fin de semana
classes.objective: Expresar una intención y organizar un plan sencillo con día, hora y lugar.
classes.s2Details:
Wants and Interests / Deseos e intereses -> I want to relax this weekend. | I would like to visit the new park. | Use these forms before confirming a plan.
Going To for an Intention / Intención -> I am going to study Saturday morning. | We are going to play soccer. | be + going to + base verb
Add Plan Details / Añadir detalles -> Day: on Saturday | Time: at three o’clock | Place: at the community center

classes.title: Class 6: Invitations—Accepting & Declining / Clase 6: Invitaciones—aceptar y rechazar
classes.objective: Make invitations and accept or decline them politely with a clear follow-up.
classes.s2Details:
Make an Invitation 💌 / Invitar -> Would you like to watch a movie? | Do you want to play soccer? | Yes, I would love to!
Give a Reason 💬 / Dar una razón -> I have soccer practice. | I need to study for a test. | How about Sunday?
Suggest Another Time 📅 -> How about Sunday? | Maybe another day. | Are you free tomorrow?

classes.title: Class 7: Clothing Store - Prices, Sizes & Payment / Clase 7: Tienda de ropa - Precios, tallas y pago
classes.objective: Preguntar precio, talla y color, probar una opción y pagar con cortesía.
classes.s2Details:
Clothes in a Store 👕 -> Hoodie, T-shirt, jeans, jacket | Sneakers, boots, cap | How much is this hoodie?
Choose an Item ✅ -> I would like this jacket. | These sneakers are comfortable. | I will take it.
Pay Politely 💳 -> I will take it. | Can I pay by card? | Thank you. Have a nice day!

classes.title: Class 8: Café Ordering & Menu Questions / Clase 8: Pedidos y preguntas de menú
classes.objective: Leer opciones, pedir, aclarar y pagar en una cafetería.
classes.s2Details:
Café Food 🥪 / Comida de cafetería -> Sandwich, burger, pizza slice | Chips, cookies, fruit, salad | Item = what you can order
Ask About Options ❓ -> What drinks do you have? | Does it come with fries? | I prefer juice to soda.
Preferences and Payment 💳 -> I prefer juice to soda. | That is all, thank you. | Can I pay by card?

classes.title: Class 9: Digital Habits, Purpose & Safety / Clase 9: Hábitos, propósito y seguridad digital
classes.objective: Usar use...to y frecuencia para analizar una rutina digital.
classes.s2Details:
Devices and Apps 📱 -> Phone, laptop, tablet, headphones | Chat app, music app, game, browser | I use my phone to chat with friends.
How Often? ⏰ -> Always, usually, sometimes, never | I usually listen to music online. | Use a strong password.
Smart Online Choices 🔒 -> Use a strong password. | Don't share private information. | Ask an adult when something feels wrong.

classes.title: Class 10: Chats, Help Calls & Trip Planning / Clase 10: Chats, llamadas de ayuda y planificación de viajes
classes.objective: Ask for clarification, exchange planning details, and confirm a date, time, place, and task.
classes.s2Details:
Ask for Help 🙋 / Pedir ayuda -> Can you help me, please? | Could you send me the address? | Could you repeat that?
Suggest and Assign Tasks ✅ -> Let's meet at the station. | I can buy the tickets. | So, we meet at 9:30 on Saturday.
Confirm the Plan 🔁 -> So, we meet at 9:30 on Saturday. | You bring the snacks, and I bring the tickets. | See you at Central Station!

levelTitle: Level 2 - Teen Adventurer / Nivel 2 - Aventurero adolescente

classes.title: Class 1: Animals & Habitats / Clase 1: Animales y hábitats
classes.objective: Describe animals, habitats, and basic abilities.
classes.s2Details:
Pets & Wild Animals 🐾 / Mascotas y Animales -> Pets: Dog, cat, hamster, parrot, bunny | Wild: Lion, elephant, monkey, dolphin, eagle, snake | A hamster is small and friendly. A lion is wild and strong. | Forest = bosque / Ocean = océano / Desert = desierto
The Animal & Habitat Formula 🦁 / Fórmula de Animales -> Formula: A [Animal] lives in the [Habitat] and can [Ability]. | Example: 'A dolphin lives in the ocean and can swim very fast.'
Quick Check: Safari Guide 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'A ________ lives in the ________ and can ________.' | Say your sentence out loud!

classes.title: Class 2: My Room & Dream House / Clase 2: Mi cuarto y casa soñada
classes.objective: Describe rooms, furniture, and dream houses with there is/there are.
classes.s2Details:
Rooms at Home & Furniture 🛏️🚪 / Habitaciones y Muebles -> Bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom, gaming corner | Desk, bed, wardrobe, sofa, bookshelf, gaming chair | My bedroom is my favorite space to relax and study. | There is a comfortable bed in my bedroom.
The Room Description Formula 🛋️ / Fórmula de Cuarto -> Formula: In my room, there is a [Furniture] and there are [Items] [Preposition] the [Location]. | Example: 'In my room, there is a gaming chair next to the desk.'
Quick Check: Room Tour 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher 2 things in your bedroom: | 'In my room, there is a ________ and there are ________.'

classes.title: Class 3: City Navigation & Transport / Clase 3: Navegación urbana y transporte
classes.objective: Usar go by, city places y direcciones breves para completar una ruta.
classes.s2Details:
City Places & Transportation 🚌🏙️ / Transporte y Ciudad -> Bus, subway, bike, scooter, taxi, train, walking | Mall, park, library, cinema, skatepark, stadium | I usually go to school by bus or on foot. | Go BY bus / BY train / BY car / BY subway
The City Route Formula 🚇 / Fórmula de Rutas -> Formula: To go to the [City Place], I go by [Transport] because it is [Reason]. | Example: 'To go to the mall, I go by subway because it is fast and cheap.'
Quick Check: City Navigator 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'When I go to ________, I travel by ________ because ________.'

classes.title: Class 4: Dream Jobs & Professions / Clase 4: Trabajos soñados y profesiones
classes.objective: Talk about jobs, workplaces, and what you want to be.
classes.s2Details:
Dream Jobs & Workplaces 💼🏢 / Profesiones Soñadas -> Software developer, graphic designer, veterinarian, pilot, doctor | Game streamer, architect, scientist, teacher, chef | Tech company, hospital, design studio, airport, laboratory | I want to be a software engineer because I love creating apps.
The Dream Career Formula 🚀 / Fórmula de Carrera -> Formula: I want to be a [Job] because I love [Interest] and I am good at [Skill]. | Example: 'I want to be a game designer because I love art and coding.' | I want to be a software engineer because I love creating apps.
Quick Check: Future Pitch 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'In the future, I want to be a ________ because ________.'

classes.title: Class 5: Habilidades con can / can’t / Clase 5: Habilidades con can / can’t
classes.objective: Talk about abilities using can, can’t, and short answers.
classes.s2Details:
Talents & Skill Verbs ⚡🎤 / Habilidades y Talentos -> Play guitar, code websites, speak French, edit videos | Do a backflip, skate on ramps, draw realistic portraits | Everyone has a unique superpower! | I can edit videos easily, but I can't play the drums.
The Talent Show Formula 🌟 / Fórmula de Talento -> Formula: I can [Skill] [Degree of Ability], but I can't [Skill 2]. | Example: 'I can edit videos very well, but I can't play the guitar.'
Quick Check: Talent Reveal 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 1. What is one cool skill you can do well? | 2. One skill you want to learn this year!

classes.title: Class 6: Reglas escolares with must, have to, should / Clase 6: Reglas escolares con must, have to, should
classes.objective: Use must, have to, and should for school rules and advice.
classes.s2Details:
School & Lab Rules 🏫📌 / Reglas Escolares -> Be on time, wear your student ID, respect classmates | Turn off your phone in class, don't run in hallways | Keep the science lab clean and wear safety goggles. | MUST = Strict rule (You must wear a helmet).
The Rule & Advice Formula 📋 / Fórmula de Reglas -> Formula: At school, you must [Obligation] and you should [Advice]. | Example: 'At school, you must arrive on time and you should ask questions in class.'
Quick Check: School Principal 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Give 1 strict rule and 1 piece of advice for new students: | 'You MUST ________ and you SHOULD ________.'

classes.title: Class 7: Sports, Health & Habit Frequency / Clase 7: Deportes, salud y frecuencia
classes.objective: Describir una semana saludable con deportes, descanso, agua y frecuencia.
classes.s2Details:
Sports, Workouts & Active Life ⚽🏃‍♀️ / Deportes y Actividad -> Basketball, soccer, swimming, volleyball, cycling, martial arts | Cardio workout, stretching, gym, yoga | Active habits improve mood and focus! | Every day, twice a week, three times a week, rarely
The Healthy Routine Formula ❤️ / Fórmula Saludable -> Formula: I practice [Sport/Activity] [Frequency] because it helps me [Benefit]. | Example: 'I go swimming twice a week because it helps me relieve stress.'
Quick Check: Health Coach 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'I practice ________ (how often?) because ________.'

classes.title: Class 8: Plan a City Outing / Clase 8: Planificar una salida por la ciudad
classes.objective: Elegir un lugar, proponer transporte y confirmar un plan grupal.
classes.s2Details:
City Outings & Hangout Spots 🎬🛹 / Lugares para Salir -> Cinema, shopping mall, skatepark, bowling alley, escape room | Café, amusement park, food truck festival, arcade | Where do you like hanging out with friends? | Let's go to the cinema this Saturday!
The Outing Proposal Formula 🎟️ / Fórmula de Salida -> Formula: 'How about going to the [Place] on [Day] at [Time] by [Transport]?' | Example: 'How about going to the arcade on Friday at 5 PM by subway?'
Quick Check: Plan a Weekend Outing 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Invite the teacher to a cool hangout: | 'Let's go to the ________ this weekend! We can meet at ________.'

classes.title: Class 9: Describir series, películas, juegos and música / Clase 9: Describir series, películas, juegos y música
classes.objective: Describe series, movies, games, and music using opinion adjectives.
classes.s2Details:
Media, Shows, Gaming & Music 🎧🎬 / Entretenimiento -> Anime series, action movies, open-world games, hip-hop, pop | Streaming series, podcasts, multiplayer games | What are you currently watching or playing? | Exciting, addictive, boring, overrated, masterpiece, emotional

The Movie Pitch Formula 🍿 / Fórmula de Sinopsis -> Formula: 'When [Protagonist] CAME ACROSS [Mystery], they had to STEP UP to [Challenge] before it TURNED OUT to be [Twist].' | Example: 'When teen hackers came across an encrypted signal, they stepped up to save their city.' | STEP UP = to take leadership ('When the captain was injured, Leo stepped up.')

Past Modals of Deduction: Must have, Could have, Can't have 🕵️⏳ / Deducción en Pasado -> MUST HAVE + Participle (95% sure it happened): 'She must have forgotten her phone at school.' | COULD / MIGHT HAVE (50% possibility): 'They might have missed the 5:00 PM train.' | CAN'T HAVE (99% impossible): 'He can't have broken the window—he was with us all afternoon.' | Clue: The window was open and the prize trophy was missing.
The Forensic Investigation Formula ⚖️ / Fórmula Forense -> Formula: Given that [Past Evidence], the suspect MUST/CAN'T HAVE [Past Action] because [Reason]. | Example: 'Given that the floor was dry, it CAN'T HAVE rained last night.' | Deduction: 'It CAN'T HAVE been an accident because the lock was forced.'

The Esports Strategy Formula 🎯 / Fórmula de Estrategia -> Formula: 'Provided that we [Condition], we will [Victory Outcome] as long as [Team Rule].' | Example: 'Provided that we communicate clearly, we will win the tournament as long as we stay calm.' | AS LONG AS / PROVIDED THAT = Only if ('You can join the esports team as long as you maintain your grades.')

classes.s2Details:
Reporting Verb Meaning / Significado del verbo de reporte -> say / explain / claim / admit / deny | The verb shows the speaker’s purpose or position. | Choose it from evidence, not personal bias.
Report Questions / Reportar preguntas -> She asked where the event was. | He wanted to know whether the post was real. | Use statement word order.
Report Requests / Reportar peticiones -> She asked me to delete the photo. | They told us not to share the link. | verb + person + to-infinitive

classes.title: Class 6: Non-Defining & Reduced Relative Clauses / Clase 6: Relative clauses explicativas y reducidas
classes.objective: Combinar información mediante defining, non-defining y reduced relative clauses.
classes.s2Details:
Authentic Idioms for Modern Teens 🗣️🔥 / Modismos Auténticos -> BITE THE BULLET = encarar una situación difícil con valor ('It's time to bite the bullet and practice.') | HIT THE NAIL ON THE HEAD = dar exactamente en el clavo ('Your analysis hit the nail on the head.') | BURN THE MIDNIGHT OIL = trasnochar estudiando con dedicación ('I burned the midnight oil for exams.') | SPILL THE BEANS = revelar un secreto ('Don't spill the beans about the surprise party!')
The Idiomatic Storytelling Formula 🎭 / Fórmula Idiomática -> Formula: 'When we faced [Challenge], we decided to [Idiom], and finally [Outcome].' | Example: 'When the deadline approached, we burned the midnight oil and finished our prototype on time.'
Quick Check: Idiom in Action 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'Before we start the presentation, let's make sure we are ________.'

classes.title: Class 7: Passive Reporting & Technology Processes / Clase 7: Reporte pasivo y procesos tecnológicos
classes.objective: Usar is said to, is believed to y pasivas de proceso para explicar tecnología y noticias.
classes.s2Details:
Three-Part Inseparable Phrasal Verbs 🚀🧠 / Verbos de 3 Partes -> COME UP WITH = inventar / idear una solución ('We came up with an eco-friendly design.') | LOOK DOWN ON = subestimar / mirar en menos ('Never look down on someone's background.') | PUT UP WITH = tolerar / aguantar ('Our team won't put up with disrespectful behavior.') | SORT OUT = solucionar un conflicto ('Let's sit down and sort out this schedule issue.')
The Executive Leadership Formula 🏆 / Fórmula Ejecutiva -> Formula: 'As leaders, we must STAND UP FOR [Cause] and CARRY OUT [Action Plan] to SORT OUT [Problem].' | Example: 'We must stand up for campus sustainability and carry out zero-waste initiatives.'
Quick Check: President's Call to Action 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'Our club has ________ an innovative solution to reduce plastic waste.'

classes.title: Class 8: Idioms, Collocations & Register / Clase 8: Idioms, colocaciones y registro
classes.objective: Usar idioms y collocations sin forzarlos y adaptar el registro al contexto.
classes.s2Details:
The Architecture of Sophisticated Argumentation 🏛️🤖 / Debate de IA y Ética -> Claim -> Warrant (Logic) -> Data (Empirical Evidence) -> Impact | Opening: 'The ethical dilemma of generative AI centers on intellectual property and human dignity.' | Rebuttal: 'While innovation must advance, safety guardrails are non-negotiable.' | 'NOTWITHSTANDING the economic benefits, the environmental cost is unsustainable.'
The Oxford Forum Rebuttal Formula 🎙️ / Fórmula de Debate -> Formula: 'Notwithstanding [Opponent Claim], empirical data proves that [Counter-Reality]; therefore, we must [Strategic Policy].' | Example: 'Notwithstanding tech optimism, studies prove algorithmic bias; therefore, we must enforce ethical audits.'
Quick Check: AI Ethics Rebuttal 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Use 'Notwithstanding' or 'Be that as it may': | '________ the efficiency of AI, human empathy and creativity remain irreplaceable.'

levelTitle: Elite - Academic and Leadership English / Elite - Inglés académico y liderazgo

classes.title: Class 1: Goal Setting & Strategic Roadmaps / Clase 1: Metas y hojas de ruta estratégicas
classes.objective: Presentar una hoja de ruta realista que conecte meta, hitos, acciones y medición.
classes.s2Details:
Future Continuous vs Future Perfect 🚀⏳ / Futuro Continuo vs Perfecto -> Future Continuous (WILL BE DOING): In progress at a future moment ('At 8 PM, I will be hosting the keynote.') | Future Perfect (WILL HAVE DONE): Completed by a future deadline ('By 2030, our venture will have reached 1 million users.') | Precision in future timeframes projects authority. | By next quarter, our AI algorithm WILL HAVE PROCESSED 10 million data points.
The Tech Forecasting Formula 📊 / Fórmula de Pronóstico -> Formula: 'By [Future Year], our initiative will have [Accomplishment] while our team is [Ongoing Impact].' | Example: 'By 2030, our lab will have developed biodegradable polymers while our engineers are expanding solar micro-grids.'
Quick Check: 2035 Tech Vision 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Tell the teacher: | 'By 2035, humanity will have ________.' (Use will have + participle)

classes.title: Class 2: Past Decisions & Modal Deduction / Clase 2: Decisiones pasadas y deducción modal
classes.objective: Usar must have, might have y can’t have para evaluar qué probablemente ocurrió y por qué.
classes.s2Details:
High-Stakes Mixed Conditionals ⚖️🌪️ / Condicionales Mixtos -> 'If the board had addressed the security flaw last month, our servers wouldn't be compromised today.' | Past decision (Had + Participle) -> Current state (Would be) | Crucial tool for crisis leadership and root-cause post-mortems. | 'If our lead scientist weren't so exceptionally innovative, we wouldn't have discovered the vaccine so quickly.'
The High-Stakes Dilemma Formula 🧭 / Fórmula de Dilema -> Formula: 'If our leadership had not [Past Ethical Action], our enterprise would [Negative Present State] today.' | Example: 'If we had not diversified our supply chain, our operations would be halted today.' | 'If our lead scientist weren't so exceptionally innovative, we wouldn't have discovered the vaccine so quickly.'
Quick Check: Strategic Post-Mortem 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Complete the crisis analysis: | 'If the tech startup had tested the update, the app ________ (not crash) today.' (wouldn't crash / wouldn't have crashed)

classes.title: Class 3: Hedging & Nuanced Positions / Clase 3: Hedging y posiciones matizadas
classes.objective: Construir una postura matizada mediante hedging, concesión y cautela.
classes.s2Details:
Cleft Sentences & Emphatic Rhetoric 🔦✨ / Oraciones Hendidas -> Standard: 'We need digital literacy education.' | Wh-Cleft: 'WHAT WE URGENTLY NEED IS digital literacy education.' | It-Cleft: 'IT IS our youth WHO will drive democratic renewal.' | 'ALL WE ARE ASKING FOR is equal access to STEM opportunities.'
The Cleft Oratory Formula 🏛️ / Fórmula de Énfasis -> Formula: 'What [Audience/We] must recognize is that [Undeniable Truth].' | Example: 'What global leaders must recognize is that youth innovation is our greatest asset.'
Quick Check: Cleft Punchline 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Transform with 'What... is': 'We need courage and creativity.' | 'What we need is ________.'

classes.title: Class 4: Academic Argument Structure / Clase 4: Estructura de la argumentación académica
classes.objective: Escribir y revisar un argumento académico breve con una estructura verificable.
classes.s2Details:
Rhetorical Inversions for Oratory 🏛️⚡ / Inversiones Retóricas -> Standard: 'I have rarely seen such dedication.' | Inverted: 'SELDOM HAVE I SEEN such unprecedented dedication.' | Rule: Negative/Limiting Adverb + Auxiliary + Subject + Verb | NOT ONLY... BUT ALSO: 'Not only DID WE WIN the tournament, but we also broke the state record.'
The Inverted Oratorical Formula 📜 / Fórmula de Inversión -> Formula: 'Not only did our venture [Action 1], but we also [Monumental Milestone].' | Example: 'Not only did our team reduce carbon emissions by 40%, but we also generated sustainable revenue.'
Quick Check: Oratorical Inversion 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Complete with inverted order: 'Never ________ (I / see) such brilliance.' | 'Never have I seen / Never I have seen'?

classes.title: Class 5: Leadership Styles & Team Strengths / Clase 5: Estilos de liderazgo y fortalezas de equipo
classes.objective: Justificar cómo organizar un equipo, delegar tareas y ofrecer retroalimentación útil.
classes.s2Details:
Diplomatic Hedging & Nuanced Softening 🕊️🤝 / Suavización Diplomática -> Direct: 'Your proposal is too expensive.' | Hedged: 'It WOULD APPEAR THAT the proposed budget MAY EXCEED our current allocation.' | Hedging protects relationships while asserting strategic boundaries. | 'Tends to suggest...' / 'Arguably the most viable path...' / 'To some extent...'
The Diplomatic Hedging Blueprint 🤝 / Fórmula Diplomática -> Formula: 'The data WOULD TEND TO SUGGEST that [Observation]; therefore, it MIGHT BE PRUDENT to [Nuanced Proposal].' | Example: 'The data would suggest rising latency; therefore, it might be prudent to upgrade server capacity.'
Quick Check: Diplomatic Softening 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Soften: 'Your timeline is impossible.' | 'It would appear that the timeline might be ________.' (slightly ambitious / terrible)

classes.title: Class 6: Future Timelines & Goal Forecasting / Clase 6: Líneas de tiempo futuras y proyección de metas
classes.objective: Presentar qué estará ocurriendo y qué se habrá completado en distintos puntos del futuro.
classes.s2Details:
Advanced Discursive Essay Architecture 🏛️📚 / Ensayo Discursivo -> 1. Introduction: Hook + Broad Context + Thesis Statement | 2. Body 1: Affirmative arguments with empirical citations | 3. Body 2: Counter-arguments and robust dialectical rebuttal | CORROBORATION: Furthermore, Moreover, In tandem with
The Discursive Thesis Formula 📜 / Fórmula de Tesis -> Formula: 'Although [Prevailing View], empirical evidence demonstrates that [Core Thesis]; hence, [Policy Recommendation].' | Example: 'Although automation increases efficiency, evidence demonstrates that human oversight remains vital; hence, ethical audits are mandatory.'
Quick Check: Scholarly Connector 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Complete: 'The experiment proved scalable. ________, further trials were approved.' | (Consequently / But)

classes.title: Class 7: Mixed Conditionals & Decision Consequences / Clase 7: Condicionales mixtos y consecuencias
classes.objective: Analizar cómo una decisión pasada afecta el presente o cómo una condición actual habría cambiado el pasado.
classes.s2Details:
Empirical Abstracts & Literature Synthesis 🔬📊 / Resúmenes Empíricos -> Abstract Structure: Background -> Objective -> Methodology -> Results -> Conclusion | Synthesizing literature: 'Smith (2022) posits that... whereas Chen (2023) contends that...' | Active scholarly verbs: demonstrates, substantiates, refutes, corroborates | 'The data yielded a statistically significant correlation (p < 0.01).'
The Empirical Abstract Formula 🧪 / Fórmula de Abstract -> Formula: 'This study investigates [Phenomenon] utilizing [Methodology]. The results corroborate that [Discovery] (p < 0.05).' | Example: 'This study investigates biodegradable polymers utilizing mass spectrometry. The results corroborate that tensile strength increases by 25%.' | 'A 95% confidence interval indicates robust model replicability.'
Quick Check: Scholarly Verb Selection 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Complete: 'Our empirical findings ________ (substantiate / say) the original hypothesis.'

classes.title: Class 8: Diplomatic Emphasis - Clefts & Inversion / Clase 8: Énfasis diplomático - Clefts e inversión
classes.objective: Usar cleft sentences e inversión para destacar ideas con control de tono.
classes.s2Details:
Executive Boardrooms & Parliamentary Procedure 🏛️⚖️ / Procedimiento Parlamentario -> 'I move to adopt the resolution on campus clean energy.' | 'Point of order, Mr. Chair: does this motion require a two-thirds majority?' | 'I second the motion / The floor is open for debate.' | 'Let us return to our core fiduciary duty and review the audited statements.'
The Formal Motion Formula 📋 / Fórmula de Moción -> Formula: 'I move that the board [Approve/Adopt] [Resolution] in order to [Strategic Objective].' | Example: 'I move that the board allocate 15% of annual reserves to youth research fellowships.'
Quick Check: Parliamentary Motion 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Propose a formal motion to the board chair: | 'Mr. Chair, I move that we ________ the proposal.' (adopt / do)

classes.title: Class 9: Academic Presentation, Defense & Q&A / Clase 9: Presentación académica, defensa y preguntas
classes.objective: Presentar una tesis, sintetizar apoyo y responder preguntas académicas con cautela.
classes.s2Details:
Crisis Leadership & The 3-Pillar Framework 🌪️🎙️ / Liderazgo en Crisis -> 1. Immediate Accountability: Take responsibility without making excuses. | 2. Transparent Remediation: Detail concrete steps to resolve the issue. | 3. Systemic Prevention: Implement long-term safeguards against recurrence. | Journalist: 'Isn't this data breach a sign of catastrophic incompetence?'
The Crisis Press Statement Formula 🎙️ / Fórmula de Crisis -> Formula: 'We take full responsibility for [Issue]. We have deployed [Immediate Fix] and instituted [Long-Term Safeguard].' | Example: 'We take full responsibility for the server outage. We have deployed backup clusters and expanded capacity by 300%.'
Quick Check: Executive Pivot 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Pivot away from hostile accusation: | 'While I understand that concern, what is critical to focus on is ________.'

classes.title: Class 10: Meeting Facilitation & Team Decisions / Clase 10: Facilitación de reuniones y decisiones de equipo
classes.objective: Facilitar una reunión, distribuir participación y cerrar con decisiones y responsables.
classes.s2Details:
Designing a Scalable Global Venture 🚀📊 / Economía Unitaria -> CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) vs LTV (Lifetime Value): Target LTV/CAC > 3x. | Gross Margin, Churn Rate, Payback Period, TAM (Total Addressable Market). | A viable venture combines solving a real pain point with sound unit economics. | 'We enable [Target Customer] to [Core Benefit] without [Major Friction] by leveraging [Proprietary Tech].'
The Seed Stage Venture Formula 💡 / Fórmula de Venture -> Formula: 'We solve [Market Pain Point] for [Audience] with [Proprietary Tech], achieving [LTV/CAC Metric].' | Example: 'We automate eco-audits for schools with computer vision, achieving a 4x LTV/CAC ratio.'
Quick Check: 30-Second Venture Elevator Pitch 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Deliver your value proposition to an investor: | 'We help ________ achieve ________ through our proprietary ________.'

classes.title: Class 11: Entrepreneurship & Conference Pitch / Clase 11: Pitch de emprendimiento o conferencia
classes.objective: Presentar y defender un pitch breve, claro y convincente ante preguntas de una audiencia.
classes.s2Details:
Level 9 Grand Capstone: Global Venture Keynote 🌍👑 / Proyecto Final -> The 7-Stage Keynote Architecture: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Tech Moat -> Unit Economics -> Team -> Ask | Synthesizing Level 9 Elite Rhetoric: Inversions, Clefts, Mixed Conditionals, and Empirical Precision. | Commanding the international tech stage as a visionary youth founder. | Investor: 'What stops Google or Meta from copying this in three months?'
The Grand Elite Keynote Formula 🏆 / Fórmula de Graduación -> 1. Open with an inverted hook or cleft statement. | 2. Present your scalable venture architecture and empirical metrics. | 3. Close with a visionary call to action for seed investors.
Quick Check: Grand Elite Keynote Pitch 🎯 / Gran Reto -> Deliver your 30-second Level 9 Grand Capstone Seed Pitch to the Venture Capital Panel! | Demonstrate mastery of inversions, unit economics, and elite C1 fluency!

classes.s2Details:
Geopolitical Statecraft & Multilateral Treaties 🌐🏛️ / Geopolítica y Cumbres -> Bilateral concessions, non-proliferation accords, binding vs non-binding resolutions. | The mechanics of veto power and diplomatic quorum in the UN Security Council. | Balancing national sovereignty with planetary collective action. | 'The General Assembly, RECALLING its resolution 75/1...'
The UN Security Council Resolution Formula 🌐 / Fórmula de Resolución -> Formula: 'Recognizing [Shared Global Crisis], the Council calls upon [Member States] to [Binding Diplomatic Action].' | Example: 'Recognizing rising sea levels, the Council calls upon member states to establish an international climate refugee resettlement accord.'
Quick Check: UN Delegate Resolution 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Draft a 1-sentence UN resolution operative clause: | 'The delegation proposes that all member states ________ by 2030.'

Cinematography, Mise-en-Scène & Literary Deconstruction 🎬📖 / Crítica Estética -> Mise-en-Scène: Lighting, framing, spatial geography, color palette, costume. | Diegetic sound (inside the film world) vs Non-diegetic sound (the orchestral score). | Subtext and unreliable narrators in post-modern literature. | 'The director employs chiaroscuro lighting to symbolize the protagonist's moral ambiguity.'
The Film & Literary Critique Formula 🎭 / Fórmula de Crítica -> Formula: 'Through [Aesthetic/Cinematic Technique], the work illustrates [Subtext], establishing itself as a [Critical Verdict].' | Example: 'Through handheld cinematography and natural lighting, the film captures raw adolescent vulnerability, establishing itself as a modern classic.' | 'A haunting auditory motif underscores the theme of generational trauma.'
Quick Check: Film Festival Jury Verdict 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Deliver a 1-sentence film critique using 'mise-en-scène' or 'subtext': | 'The director's use of ________ symbolizes ________.'

Rhodes & Fulbright Fellowship Defense 🎓🏛️ / Entrevistas de Beca Rhodes -> The Rhodes/Fulbright Selection Board: Looking for moral character, leadership instinct, and intellectual breadth. | Navigating ethical dilemmas and questions of global justice. | The balance between ambitious visionary claims and humble self-awareness. | Board Question: 'Isn't your proposed policy hopelessly idealistic in a fragmented geopolitical world?'
The Fellowship Board Defense Formula 🏆 / Fórmula Rhodes -> Formula: 'My research addresses [Global Injustice] through [Academic Field], utilizing this fellowship to [Planetary Impact].' | Example: 'My research addresses clean water access through nanotech filtration, utilizing this fellowship to deploy decentralized systems across Latin America.'
Quick Check: Fellowship Defense Statement 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Deliver your core mission statement to the Rhodes Selection Board: | 'I seek this fellowship to leverage [Field] in order to [Global Impact].'

The Investigative Video Essay Formula 🎬 / Fórmula Documental -> Formula: 'Behind the surface of [Accepted Norm] lies [Investigative Discovery], forcing us to question [Fundamental System].' | Example: 'Behind the surface of clean tech supply chains lies severe cobalt extraction, forcing us to question the true cost of our digital future.'
Quick Check: Investigative Cold Open 🎯 / Mini Reto -> Deliver an investigative documentary cold open hook to the teacher: | 'In [Year], a single discovery in [Place] changed everything we thought we knew about ________.'
